text:
Lee Park: Hi all! Lee here, starting as backend infra. Moved from Seattle. I bike to work and bring too many thermoses. Quick q: is there covered bike parking? Also curious where folks get lunch near the office.

Nico (People Ops): Welcome Lee!! :tada: Covered racks are in the garage level B2, security will enable your badge. Team usually heads to Mercado for tacos or orders from PokeTown. Lunch meetup at 12:30 in the kitchen if you want to join.

Hugo: welcome!! If you like spicy food Mercado has a good bowl. Also we keep a community tool chest in the lounge for basic bike fixes.

DevBot: Onboarding reminder: complete "Security basics" training by EOD.

Lee Park: Thanks! Map of garage? I can swing by later to check card access.

Avery: hi Lee 44b I can show you the bike racks after lunch. Also we have a small pump and patch kit in the closet.

Lee Park: Perfect, thanks everyone. See you at 12:30 37d

Nico (People Ops): Dropped a welcome sticker and snack box on your desk. Ping me if card still blocked.

Hugo: ping re: team standup at 3pm if you want to meet the infra folks.

Lee Park: Will join the standup. Excited to be here :)
